Are you looking to invest in Dubai’s real estate market? If so, let me take this opportunity to tell you why Emaar is your best bet to get the ROI you deserve. With a slew of Dubai off-plan projects taking the market by a storm, Emaar is at the forefront as the developer of most of these well-crafted communities. Dubai Real Estate Market is going through an interesting phase currently and is looking to stabilize soon. If you want to make the most of the current market, this is the best time to invest in Dubai real estate market.

#1 No.1 Real Estate Developer in the World

Emaar Properties is ranked the 20th best-regarded companies in the world by Forbes Magazine, making it the top real estate company in the world.

#2 The Most Trusted Developer

With a strong global standing & exposure, Emaar is a world-recognized real estate brand & has the maximum transactions in the region.

#3 Iconic World-Famous Projects

Burj Khalifa, the world’s tallest building, and The Dubai Mall, the world’s largest mall are all a part of Emaar’s impressive portfolio.

#4 The Best Communities & Amenities

Emaar has a great reputation in crafting the perfect communities for residents, including significant master developments of Dubai such as Downtown Dubai and Dubai Marina

#5 Expat-ownership of Properties

All properties by Emaar can be owned by expatriates in Dubai, making them the perfect option to invest and own in Dubai.

#6 Highest Number of Handovers

Emaar is known for the timely and the maximum number of handovers in the region

#7 Emaar – The Leading Off-Plan Developers

With over 5 major master projects in the pipeline, Emaar is introducing innovative community living for everyone in Dubai. With over 30,000 residential units in just 1 of these master projects, Emaar is set to deliver amazing homes this year.

#8 75% Real Estate Market Share in Dubai

Emaar has a 75% market share in Dubai’s Real Estate Market and has over 90,000+ deliveries in the past.

In conclusion, if you invest in Emaar, your investment is not only in safe hands, but you are also promised a high capital appreciation and happy tenants. A real estate developer with immense reputation, both within the region and internationally, Emaar, always delivers every project with absolute luxurious finesse.

Choose Emaar because everyone wants to live in an Emaar community.

Why Choose Dubai?

If you are on the fence about choosing Dubai, this is the most popular real estate investment city in the world. Whether you like a global city setting with a bustling pulse, a quaint villa with an equestrian lifestyle, or a bit of both, choose Dubai… Here’s an overview of the various reasons why:

  • Investment Security
  • Fairly Priced Market
  • High per capita GDP
  • Top Tourist Destination
  • Stable Currency
  • Long Term Visa
  • High ROI
  • Zero Tax
  • Low Real Estate Bubble Index Risk
  • 100% Business Ownership
  • Rise in Population
  • Regulated Market

To get a more detailed look at the reasons to invest in Dubai, click here.

With all these various reasons to support your decision, you can be rest-assured with Dubai as your real estate investment destination. Your capital increment is guaranteed with Emaar in this city. With a wide array of investment options to choose from, with flexible payment plans and on-time handovers, you are spoilt for choice.
